title: Q-ROOT-estimate-miscalibrated: estimate-miscalibrated keeps recurring: Recalibrate the forecaster from settled outcomes until its Brier score beats a coin.
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe estimate-miscalibrated
**Status:** closed

Root cause class `estimate-miscalibrated` recurred on 1 days (2026-11-21); the guard does not exist yet: build it, because the guard is the fix.
Root cause: predictions were scored against outcomes without feeding the score back into the forecaster
Guard: `grep:foundation/decisions.py::recalibrat`
Remedy: Recalibrate the forecaster from settled outcomes until its Brier score beats a coin.
Symptoms seen:
- inbox:yearfail-brier-score-worse-than-a-coin-p: Yearfail Brier score worse than a coin (practical-solutions#192)
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe estimate-miscalibrated

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T22:53:00Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
